'''Heating systems''' were a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] enhancement available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The system consisted of double-insulation and small, efficient heating elements that prevented the wearer from suffering in low temperatures and allowed them to survive in environments dozens of degrees below what would normally be tolerable. Heating systems could be installed in any sealable armor that covered the entire body, and were installed in the [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|laminate armor]] of Imperial [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]]. Other models of heating system included [[Atlas Corp]]'s [[DL87 armor enhancement]] and the [[Min-Dal Company]]'s [[Model 00 heating system]]. The systems usually cost about 1000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to install.<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Heating systems were first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]]. The same information was also included in the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] released the [[2014|following year]] by Fantasy Flight Games.
